# Room map

*turns an Apple RoomPlan .usdz scan into a compact spatial prompt block (named objects + bounding boxes)* — `tools/room_map.py`, 1 tool.

!!! abstract "From the module docstring"
    🗺️ room_map — turn an Apple RoomPlan .usdz scan into a Scout-ready spatial prompt block. The scan's meshes are SEMANTICALLY NAMED (toilet0, sofa_rect0, refrigerator0, wall_*, door_*, floor_<Room>_*), so we don't need photos — we read object labels + bounding boxes straight out of the USDA geometry and emit a compact, model-friendly map.

| tool | does |
|---|---|
| [`room_map`](#room_map) | 🗺️ Scout's spatial prior from a RoomPlan .usdz scan. |

## `room_map`

```python
room_map(action: str = 'show', scan_path: str = '') -> Dict[str, Any]
```

🗺️ Scout's spatial prior from a RoomPlan .usdz scan.

| argument | meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | "show" (return the map block) \| "objects" (flat object list) \| "rooms" (room summary) |
| `scan_path` | optional override path to a .usdz/.usda scan. |
